description: MLS (RFC 9420), MLS_128_DHKEMX25519_AES128GCM_SHA256_Ed25519. Gate cases only: MLS reading depends on member secrets, covered by RFC 9420's own vectors. Leaves expire at 4922289600 (Unix seconds); regenerate before then.
